summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for a local Macron Cup derby against Alsager at Hind Heath Road, with the sides set to battle it out for local pride. Joe Bevan continues to be among the league's top scorers with 135 goals this season in the NWCFL. The club are also featured in a new non-league management game, giving fans the chance to take the team to the top of the system.
